title: client.place_search (protocol v2)
description: Client -> server: search places by free text ("coffee", "Piedmont Park", an address) for live navigation (PROTOCOL_v2.md, Navigation). The server's phase1 provider (Google Places Text Search, falling back to Geocoding; the mock provider returns made-up places) answers this client only with one navigation.places echoing requestId. Sent on submit, not per keystroke; the server answers at most 2 searches per second per client. Same sender rule as client.trip_state.

requestId.description: Echoed in navigation.places (the client keeps only the answer to its newest search).

near.description: Bias results around this point (the tablet's latest GPS fix); null / absent = no bias.
